fluff.overview: The Armed Forces of the Federated Suns integrate conventional infantry directly into their Regimental Combat Teams, assigning foot, mechanized, and jump platoons to work permanently alongside BattleMech and armored formations. Foot infantry remain the backbone of AFFS planetary garrisons, cheap enough to deploy in numbers across the Federated Suns' vast territory and reliable enough to hold ground that BattleMech forces cannot permanently occupy. Configured for civil disturbance management rather than conventional military combat, these riot control troops are trained in crowd suppression, population control, and non-lethal enforcement operations on garrison worlds during periods of unrest or political transition.
